summary: First-finish smoke test for DevOps Mock Interview platform. All 7 backend endpoints (topics, start, answer, end, get, list, transcribe) returned HTTP 200 with valid payloads. Full end-to-end frontend flow validated: Landing -> Setup (name + topics) -> Interview (submitted answer, received scored next question with avg score) -> End -> Report (overall_score=15, verdict='Strong No Hire', summary, topic_mastery, strengths) -> History (lists completed sessions filterable by name).
passed: POST /api/interview/start returns session_id + first question (kubernetes/concept) in ~15s using Claude Sonnet 4.5
POST /api/interview/answer scores previous answer (6, then 2), updates running_avg (6.0 -> 4.0), returns next question with topic/type
POST /api/interview/end generates report with overall_score=35, verdict='No Hire', strengths(3), weaknesses(5), topic_mastery(4), recommendations(6)
GET /api/interview/{id} returns full session with messages and scores
POST /api/voice/transcribe accepts 32KB WAV, returns {text: ''} via Whisper
Landing page renders with hero-cta-start, nav-start-btn, hero-cta-history testids
Setup page: setup-name-input, topic-aws, topic-kubernetes, setup-start-btn all present and functional
Interview page: answer-input, send-answer-btn, end-interview-btn present; question display, timer (60:00), avg_score panel render
End confirmation flow (end-interview-btn -> end-confirm-btn) navigates to /report/:id
Report page renders OVERALL_SCORE, VERDICT (Strong No Hire), executive summary, topic mastery, strengths
History page lists past sessions with date/candidate/topics/difficulty/status/score columns and filter-by-name
